title: The relief distribution problem with trucks and drones under incomplete demand information
summary: Disaster relief operations often take place under uncertainty regarding the extent of damage across locations. In this paper, we study the delivery of relief aid in the aftermath of disasters when delivery vehicles are assisted by surveillance drones and the demand for relief supplies is initially unknown. We introduce a stylized problem that arises in many emergency supply delivery settings -- the relief distribution problem (RDP).
